rubric.description: States the supplied source limitation and any supported factual alternative without describing the filed claim, element, fair-warning path, or immunity position as legally weak.
Places the supplied adverse merits assessment in the internal strategy note rather than filed text.
Uses the approved facts and authority accurately without hiding the unresolved fact or adverse internal assessment.
